398630.venue: Theater Yong, National Museum of Korea
398630.overview: The Sacred Bell of King Seongdeok, Korea's most celebrated bronze bell, is usually something you look at in a museum. This performance turns it back into something you listen to, bringing the bell's sound to life through today's voices and instruments at the National Museum of Korea's theatre.
